scope: Vorhandene Programmdiagnosen behalten ihre gemeinsame 401-Zeilen-Zustands-/Steuerwurzel. 27 ganze Funktionen liegen in vier Fallgruppen; alle 46 Funktionen und bisherigen Orakel bleiben erhalten.

implementation.root: Original shared state, types, helpers, baseline/warm orchestration, run entry and public diagnostic entry remain in one root. Four private groups contain original whole diagnostic functions, using direct old paths. No new state, dispatch layer or test suite.
implementation.oracles: Original expected values, failure injection, stack checks, retirement, shared-resource acknowledgements and cleanup remain unchanged. The earlier 0.84.38 duplicate-helper cleanup is the actual source baseline; the 0.84.37 census is historical.

program/self_test.rs.single_state_root: Every original non-function item/impl/import line unchanged except blank separation. Children contain only original complete functions, docs/attributes and parent import.
program/self_test.rs.signature_policy: Exact type/signature tokens after required visibility and rustfmt whitespace/trailing comma only. No body formatting, algorithm, owner or lifecycle change allowed.

source_audit.preserved: Every original complete free function, type/signature, attribute/safety document and state/type/impl/import root remains. Only required child visibility and exact one-level super qualification change. Direct compile-time reexports retain used old paths; no new mutable state, copy, runtime dispatch or owner/lifetime edge.
source_audit.test_policy: Affected exact body/signature/state/path/attribute proofs and existing strict compiler/layout checks plus exactly1final common native SMP4 STANDARD. No new suite or repeated unrelated full catalog; no fresh physical hardware/exhaustive interleaving claim.

validation.native_acceptance: Actual final SMP4 STANDARD on current physically verified image; extra affected cases only when documented as needed.

comparison_previous.observation: One final run per artifact; descriptive comparison without causal speedup/parity claim or selection rerun. Original workloads/reference/STDCHILD unchanged.

test_policy: Affected exact body/signature/state/path/attribute proofs and existing strict compiler/layout checks plus exactly1final common native SMP4 STANDARD. No new suite or repeated unrelated full catalog; no fresh physical hardware/exhaustive interleaving claim.
performance_assessment: Code layout may affect performance. Exactly one final STANDARD Suite 2 SMP4 with unchanged full export and lossless GET 5/30/6 valid. No causal speedup or parity claim from one run.
limits: This is a mechanical split of existing diagnostic cases, not a new full catalog run or a correction of their expected values. The historical PROGRAMSTORAGEGUI -4096 from 0.84.17 remains an acknowledged old limit and is not relabeled as fixed or freshly tested.
